js: (() => { const d = window.__dbg; const out = {}; const measure = (name) => { const cam = d.camera.position; let calls = 0, tris = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { d.renderer.info.reset(); for (const c of d.ctx.cull) c.object.visible = c.object.userData.hide ? false : (c.x - cam.x) ** 2 + (c.z - cam.z) ** 2 < c.range * c.range; d.trees.update(cam); d.lighting.update(); d.pipeline.render(1 / 60, 100 + i / 60); calls = d.renderer.info.render.calls; tris = d.renderer.info.render.triangles; } out[name] = [calls, Math.round(tris / 1e3)]; }; const ring = d.terrain.group.children.filter((m) => { const b = m.geometry.boundingBox; return b.min.x < -320 || b.max.x > 320 || b.min.z < -320 || b.max.z > 320; }); const views = { spawn: [-126, 7.5, 24, -100, 5, 0], eastAir: [150, 80, -70, 330, 0, 10], eastEnd: [222, 6.4, 2.5, 300, 5.5, 0] }; for (const [v, p] of Object.entries(views)) { d.look(...p); measure(v + ':all'); d.town.group.visible = false; measure(v + ':noTown'); ring.forEach((m) => (m.visible = false)); measure(v + ':noTownNoRing'); d.town.group.visible = true; ring.forEach((m) => (m.visible = true)); const w = d.water; const wasR = w.reflection; } return out; })()
